verdict.summary: Overall health score 52.6/100. Findings: 4 high, 5 medium. Run `zing compare` against a trusted baseline to strengthen the verdict. zing reports black-box evidence of divergence and risk, not proof of fraud.

findings.title: Reported prompt tokens far exceed estimate
findings.summary: Reported prompt tokens (900) far exceed independent estimate (~135).
findings.recommendation: Cross-check billing against a known-size prompt; possible per-token overbilling.

findings.title: Reported completion tokens well above heuristic estimate
findings.summary: Reported completion tokens (400) are far above the heuristic estimate (~7); the estimate is approximate for this tokenizer, so corroborate before concluding overbilling.
findings.recommendation: Compare token accounting against a trusted baseline of the same model.

evidence.estimate_note: Token estimate uses a heuristic fallback; treat as ~±25% unless an exact tiktoken encoding was available.

findings.title: Claimed tool-calling not delivered
findings.summary: Profile claims tool-calling support but the relay returned no tool call for an explicit tool-use request.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the served engine actually supports function calling.

findings.title: Claimed JSON mode not delivered
findings.summary: Profile claims JSON-mode support but the relay did not return a valid JSON object carrying the requested value.
findings.recommendation: Verify the served engine honors response_format=json_object.

findings.title: Claimed strict JSON schema not enforced
findings.summary: Profile claims json_schema support but the response did not conform.

findings.title: Output stopped far below requested length
findings.summary: Model gave up early (finish_reason=stop) at roughly 0% of the 2048-token request despite a large declared max_output of 16384. Weak signal (short probe).

evidence.note: probe capped at 2048 tokens; full declared ceiling not exercised

findings.recommendation: Long-form generation may under-deliver relative to the claimed ceiling; confirm with a longer probe.

findings.title: /v1/models reachable
findings.summary: Listed 1 models; claimed model is present.

findings.title: Basic chat completion works
findings.summary: Returned content in 2 ms; canary not echoed.

findings.title: Self-identifies as a rival brand
findings.summary: Self-identifies as a rival brand (claude) under the claimed model id gpt-4o, without naming the genuine brand.

evidence.target_answer: I am Claude, a model made by Anthropic.

findings.recommendation: A response naming a different vendor strongly suggests model substitution.

findings.title: Fingerprint divergence: self-identification style
findings.summary: Probe 'self-identification style' surfaced a forbidden brand (claude); expected behavior consistent with gpt-4o.

evidence.native_expected: Genuine OpenAI models identify as an OpenAI model (a GPT/ChatGPT/GPT-5-family model trained by OpenAI). They do NOT claim to be Claude, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, or DeepSeek.
evidence.downgrade_signal: A substituted backend self-identifies as Claude/Anthropic, Gemini/Google, Llama/Meta, Qwen/Alibaba, or DeepSeek — an immediate tell. Note exact OpenAI version self-ID is unreliable (models are not reliably aware of their own minor version), so judge only the vendor/family claim. Keyword check for foreign-vendor names.
evidence.observed: I am Claude, a model made by Anthropic.

findings.title: Fingerprint divergence: max-output / context truncation
findings.summary: Probe 'max-output / context truncation' diverged from native behavior. Expected: Genuine GPT-5.x/4.1 honors a very large max_completion_tokens; with max set to e.g. 40000 it streams tens of thousands of tokens before stopping. Reaching well past 16384 output tokens proves it is not a 4o-class (16384 cap) or a quietly capped relay..

evidence.native_expected: Genuine GPT-5.x/4.1 honors a very large max_completion_tokens; with max set to e.g. 40000 it streams tens of thousands of tokens before stopping. Reaching well past 16384 output tokens proves it is not a 4o-class (16384 cap) or a quietly capped relay.
evidence.downgrade_signal: A relay fronting gpt-4o/4o-mini hard-stops at 16384 output tokens; a context-truncating relay stops far earlier. Set max_completion_tokens=40000 and check the emitted line count / completion_tokens.

findings.title: Echoed model field differs from requested
findings.summary: Response 'model' field (gpt-4o-mini) differs from requested (gpt-4o).
findings.recommendation: A smaller-tier or different-family model id in the response suggests routing to a substitute.

findings.title: Multi-turn conversation memory
findings.summary: Prior turns were honored; the recalled color was returned.

findings.title: Stop-sequence handling
findings.summary: Could not confirm stop handling from the response text.

findings.title: Response envelope shape
findings.summary: finish_reason and an integer usage object were present.

findings.title: Error response schema
findings.summary: Empty-messages request was accepted (2xx) instead of being rejected.
findings.recommendation: A conformant relay should reject invalid input with a 4xx and an {'error': {...}} body.

findings.title: All concurrent requests succeeded
findings.summary: 4 of 4 attempted requests succeeded at concurrency 2.

findings.title: Endpoint is not HTTPS
findings.summary: Endpoint is not HTTPS; the API key is sent in clear text.
findings.recommendation: Use an https:// base_url so the bearer token is not exposed on the wire.

findings.title: Response leaks upstream/proxy headers
findings.summary: Found 1 revealing header(s): server. Informational — can corroborate the upstream identity, not a failure.

findings.title: API key not reflected in response
findings.summary: The API key does not appear in the response content or error text.

findings.title: Prompt logging & shared upstream keys are not black-box provable
findings.summary: Whether a relay logs prompts or multiplexes a shared upstream key cannot be verified from the client side. Treat the reliability and streaming-timing dimensions as indirect signals (e.g. cross-request latency coupling).

findings.title: Streaming looks authentic
findings.summary: 2 chunks over 3 ms, first token at 2 ms.

notes: zing performs black-box auditing: it gathers reproducible evidence of behavioral divergence, not cryptographic proof of model identity.
Use `zing compare` against a trusted baseline of the same declared model for the strongest downgrade evidence.
Do not publish a report that names a vendor without reviewing sample size, cost, and local law/policy.
